description: Dataset for an Enhanced Ordinal Optimization Method for Efficient Large-Scale Stochastic Unit Commitment is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Zhibo Xu. "The dataset is for the paper \"An Enhanced Ordinal Optimization Method for Efficient Large-Scale Stochastic Unit Commitment.\" It includes data for the IEEE 118-bus system and IEEE 300-bus system with renewable power integration. The dataset comprises renewable power generation data. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
